# MASHBOX

> MASHBOX Labs makes open models run faster and cheaper on TPUs and accelerated hardware, as well as exploring the future of the intersection of AI and gaming. This repo is the Python package and CLI `mashbox`; the models in it run on Google Cloud TPU. Coding agents: read AGENTS.md first. docs/google-cloud.md goes from a Google account with no Cloud setup to a running model and a deleted chip.

Model code is open. Each model's TPU kernels ship compiled, as one bundle that `mashbox run` downloads and checks; models that list plain JAX as tested also run without it. A chip bills from create to delete.

## Start

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mashbox-labs/mashbox/main/AGENTS.md): rules and steps for coding agents
- [Google Cloud setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mashbox-labs/mashbox/main/docs/google-cloud.md): account, project, billing, chip, run, delete
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mashbox-labs/mashbox/main/README.md): quickstart and the models table
- [Chips](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mashbox-labs/mashbox/main/docs/chips.md): TPU v6e and v5e differences
- [Use with coding agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mashbox-labs/mashbox/main/docs/agents-on-tpu.md): Claude Code, Codex and Pi on a model you serve

## Models

<!-- models:start -->
MASHBOX builds:
- [Hy-Nomas](https://mashbox.gg/docs/models/hy-nomas): text and movement keys in, video out. World model. Runs on: TPU v6e (v6e-1): 2.46 s of compute per second of video, main model quantized (this version of `mashbox run` starts on a v6e-4); TPU v6e slice (v6e-4).
- [Qwen3.8-27B](https://mashbox.gg/docs/models/qwen3-8-27b): text in, text out. LLM. Runs on: TPU v5e (v5e-4), TPU v6e (v6e-1), TPU v6e slice (v6e-4).
- [Track2Rig](https://mashbox.gg/docs/models/track2rig): 3D point tracks in, rig (JSON and glTF) out. Rigging. Experimental. Runs on: CPU, TPU v6e.

GGUF files that run in our engine:
- Falcon3-1B-Instruct Q8_0 by Technology Innovation Institute (llama, GGUF from bartowski): Checked on CPU. `mashbox run bartowski/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-GGUF:Q8_0`
- granite-3.3-2b-instruct Q4_K_M by IBM (granite, GGUF from bartowski): Checked on CPU. `mashbox run bartowski/ibm-granite_granite-3.3-2b-instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M`
- Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct Q4_K_M by Meta (llama, GGUF from bartowski): Tested, runs on TPU v6e-1. `mashbox run bartowski/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M`
- Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct IQ4_XS by Meta (llama, GGUF from bartowski): Checked on CPU. `mashbox run bartowski/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-GGUF:IQ4_XS`
- Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 Q3_K_M by Mistral AI (llama, GGUF from bartowski): Checked on CPU. `mashbox run bartowski/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3-GGUF:Q3_K_M`
